datasets.name: ODSPayPlan
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.rowid,to_number(rownum) as No, a.*
  FROM ins_payment_plan a
where a.ins_id = :insid
order by pay_date

datasets.name: DSplancontract
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid ,a.id, a.type_id, a.ins_date, a.begin_date, a.end_date,
       a.valute_id,  ins_report.get_S_haqq(a.id) AMMOUNT ,a.close_prefix, a.kli_id, a.loanacc_id,
       a.curracc_id, a.policy_num, a.inssumm, a.franshiz, a.tariff,
       a.state, a.agent_id, a.pnum, a.ben_id, a.beneficiary,
       a.conditions, a.sugnum, a.blank_id, a.op_id, a.reins, a.chkasko,
       a.chm, a.chfq, a.commitop_id, a.commit_date, a.cancelopid,
       a.canceldate, a.filial, a.bnf_type, a.userinsert, a.insured,
       a.comission from ins_contracts a
where a.id=:p_id

datasets.name: DSPaymentsetting
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.* from ins_payment_plan_setting a
where a.cid=:pcid

datasets.name: DSPaymentInfo
datasets.sql:
select count(*) as say from ins_payment_plan
where ins_id=:pcid

datasets.name: DSPaymentSettingInfo
datasets.sql:
select count(*) as say from ins_payment_plan_setting 
where cid=:pcid

datasets.name: DSmesuliyyetShaqqi
datasets.sql:
select nvl(resp_premium,0) as SighaqqiM from ins_contract_responsibility
where cid=:pcid

datasets.name: DSFerdiqezaShaqqi
datasets.sql:
select nvl(ins_premium,0) SighaqqiF from ins_contr_per_acc_motor
where cid=:pcid
